test a weighted combination using inverse_error weights to see if weighting improves over mean given strong trend and unstable ranking.
The series has unstable ranking and strong trend; a robust median over the full pool may improve robustness.
test a softmax‑negative‑error weighted combination over the full pool to see if a more aggressive weighting improves over inverse_error.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable rankings; a robust trimmed mean over a smaller, high‑quality pool may reduce variance.
test robust DBA on full pool
Test a per‑pool weighted combination on the reduced, low‑correlation pool4 using softmax weights to see if focusing on the strongest models in that subset improves over DBA.
weighted on reduced, stable pool with inverse error weights
full pool weighted by inverse error

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 10 backtested attempts, score 0.9792. Series context: trend strength 0.9708 and seasonal strength 0.5992; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.591.
